history.note: Fictional report of wrist soreness after prior equipment work.

events.note: Mara reports new wrist soreness after moving equipment.
Mara reports swelling. The peer visual check cannot confirm swelling.
Medical records suspected local inflammation with the cause undetermined. The Commander offers a duty handoff and assigns Ivo a recheck.
Ivo records that Mara reports less soreness. The earlier conflicting observation stays in the record.

events.note: Mara reports itching near a training sensor patch.
The camera view is unavailable and the patch material record is incomplete.
Medical flags possible sensitivity to the patch and assigns Ivo to repeat the observation and check the equipment record.
Ivo completes the peer observation and logs the equipment record. The suspected trigger remains unresolved.

events.note: Mara reports fatigue during the watch.
The temperature observation is missing. A sleep log entry is available for review.

Mara reports that fatigue persists. The Medical record stays open for follow-up.
